title: Meetings At The Cantonese Club

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
23rd July 1919

REPORT ON Wen Tsung Yao and alleged meetings at the Cantonese Club.

Made by D. S. I. Sullivan. Forwarded by Chief Inspector

Sir,

Exhaustive enquiries have been made and a general watch kept on the Cantonese Club for the past two weeks and no confirmation can be obtained of the allegation that political meetings are being held there.

In the first paragraph of the attached letter the writer states that Wen Tsung Yao (溫宗堯) caused the trouble in the Cantonese Guild last year for political purposes. As a matter of fact the split in the Guild was the outcome of a personal quarrel between Wen Tsung Yao and the then secretary of the Cantonese Club, and later it developed into a fight between two parties as to who should wield predominating influence in the Club and Guild.

Tanr Chih Tsz (譚池之) is a Cantonese doctor who was, until about four years ago, in charge of a hospital in Pekin, but left there in disgrace. He is an intimate friend of Wen Tsung Yao and the two are frequently together.

He does not appear to have any regular employment. He is Chairman of the Commercial Confederate Association, a society which was very prominent during the Japanese boycott in Shanghai. whose headquarters were formerly at 364 Honan Road and are now at 13 Avenue Edward VII.

He is taking an active part in the affairs of the Chamber of Commerce as the attached advertisement from the Chinese newspaper "Shun Pao" of the 23rd inst. shows.

1919年7月23日

关于温宗尧及据称在广东人俱乐部举行集会的报告。

由副督察长沙利文（D. S. I. Sullivan）撰写。经总督察转呈

先生，

过去两周已进行详尽调查，并对广东人俱乐部实施了一般性监视，但未能获得证实有关在该处举行政治集会的指控。

在附信的第一段中，写信人称温宗尧去年出于政治目的在广东会馆制造麻烦。事实上，会馆的分裂是温宗尧与当时广东人俱乐部秘书之间个人争吵的结果，随后发展为两派争夺在俱乐部和会馆中主导权的斗争。

谭池之（Tanr Chih Tsz，音译）是一名广东籍医生，直到大约四年前一直负责北京的一家医院，但因不光彩之事离开。他是温宗尧的密友，两人经常在一起。

他似乎没有固定职业。他是商业公团联合会的会长，该社团在上海抵制日货期间非常活跃，其总部原位于河南路364号，现位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）13号。

正如本月23日中文报纸《申报》所刊登的附件广告所示，他正积极参与商会事务。

Wong Pah Bing (黄伯平) is the manager of the Doong Foo
Yoong (同孚永) Import & Export Hong, 10 Ningpo Road. He is
also a friend of Wen Tsung Yao, but, so far as can be ascertain-
ed, is not interested in the affairs of the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce.

Wen Tsung Yao (温宗尧) and Tang Chih Tsz (汤节之)
along with a couple of returned Cantonese students from
America frequently visit the club of an evening, where they are
said to be attending to the affairs of the club as the Municipal
Council refused to grant them a license.

During the recent strike a meeting of employees of foreign
firms was held at the Cantonese Club. It was very openly
arranged and Cantonese who are by no means friendly to Wen
Tsung Yao, were invited. There is nothing to show that
Wen Tsung Yao or his party had anything to do with the meeting,
and in any case the participants decided not to go on strike.

There is not much doubt that Mr Wen Tsung Yao is a schemer
and as far as his influence goes a disturbing element amongst
local Chinese, especially Cantonese, and he is probably capable
of all that is alleged against him in the attached letter, but
the party that resigned from the Cantonese Club last year when
Wen Tsung Yao got his way, are keeping a very close watch on
him and on the club, and his bitterest oponents are satisfied
that he is not holding any meetings there now.

黄伯平（Wong Pah Bing）是宁波路10号同孚永（Doong Foo Yoong）进出口行的经理。他也是温宗尧的朋友，但据查，他对中国商会的事务并不感兴趣。

温宗尧和汤节之（Tang Chih Tsz，原文如此，前文为谭池之）以及几位从美国归来的广东留学生经常在晚上光顾该俱乐部，据说他们在那里处理俱乐部事务，因为工部局拒绝向他们颁发执照。

在最近的罢工期间，外商雇员的一次会议在广东人俱乐部举行。这次会议安排得非常公开，并邀请了那些对温宗尧绝不友好的广东人。没有任何迹象表明温宗尧或其党派与该会议有任何关系，况且参与者已决定不进行罢工。

毫无疑问，温宗尧先生是一个阴谋家，就其影响力而言，他是当地中国人、尤其是广东人中的不安定因素，他很可能做得出附信中指控他的所有事情，但是去年在温宗尧得逞时退出广东人俱乐部的那一派人对他和俱乐部保持着非常严密的监视，而他最激烈的反对者确信他现在没有在那里举行任何集会。

Advertisement in Shenpao and other papers.

Provisional Members Association of the
Chamber of Commerce.

We have received a letter from 63 members including
徐 菊 如 汤 节 之
Hsu Tsoh Yu and Tang Tsih Ts to the effect that as the
Chairman and Vice Chairman, have tendered their resignations,
the Chamber of Commerce lack men to take charge of its
affairs. Shanghai being the centre of Commerce, Foreigners
and Chinese have noticed the suspension of the Chamber,
and it is very important.

We in accordance with clause 11 of the Regulations
of the Chamber, request the Committee to hold a Provisional
meeting of all members.

It has been decided to hold a meeting of members
at 3 p.m. July 26th. Apart from writing to the members
in the ordinary way, this advertisement is published
hoping that all members will lay aside their work and
attend the meeting at the appointed time, when they must
produce admission tickets.

19年7月24日

《申报》及其他报纸上的广告。

商会临时会员协会。

我们收到包括徐菊如和汤节之在内的63名会员的来信，大意是鉴于正副会长已提出辞职，商会缺乏人员主持事务。上海作为商业中心，中外人士均注意到商会的停摆，此事至关重要。

我们根据商会章程第11条，请求委员会召开全体会员临时会议。

已决定于7月26日下午3时召开会员大会。除按常规方式通知会员外，特刊登此广告，希望各位会员放下工作，准时出席会议，届时必须出示入场券。

CAPTAIN SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE.

Rough
/ Translation of a letter from Feng Zoh San (馮芳珊), Sinza Rd. (No. unknown).

July 5, 1919.

McEuen, Esq.,
C.S.P.

Sir,

I beg to state that Wen Tsung-yao (温宗堯) is a powerful member of the revolutionary party, and last year he caused trouble to the Cantonese Guild with intent to do some political work. Now he nominated his confederates named Tang Chih Tsz (湯節之) & Wong Pah Bing (黄伯平) to incite the people to overthrow and re-organize the Shanghai General Chamber of Commerce. He (Wen) utilizes peoples' wishes to work his political matters. This was published in the Chinese & Foreign newspapers.

Wen and others are now taking the opportunity of the present general situation to try to overthrow the Peking Government, and use the Cantonese Club (Upper portion of No. 10 Ningpo Road) as their communication office, where they have been holding secret meetings.

On the day when the European Peace was to be signed, Wen Tsung-yao etc were certain that Delegates of China would sign, and they influenced shopkeepers to again go on strike, and also incited people to sever connexions with the Government should the Delegates sign at the Peace Conference.

When a telegram was received from Europe to the effect that China has not yet signed, all shopkeepers decided not to go on strike. But Wen etc are still

1919年7月5日。

麦克尤恩（McEuen）先生，
中央巡捕房总监。

先生，

我谨陈述，温宗尧是革命党的重要成员，去年他为了进行某些政治活动而在广东会馆制造麻烦。现在他提名其同伙汤节之（Tang Chih Tsz，音译）和黄伯平煽动民众推翻并重组上海总商会。他（温）利用民众的愿望来推行其政治事务。此事已在中外报纸上刊登。

温等人正利用目前的总体局势，试图推翻北京政府，并利用广东人俱乐部（宁波路10号上层部分）作为他们的联络处，在那里举行秘密会议。

在欧洲和约签署之日，温宗尧等人确信中国代表将会签字，他们影响店主再次罢工，并煽动民众，如果代表在和会上签字，就与政府断绝关系。

当收到来自欧洲的电报称中国尚未签字时，所有店主决定不进行罢工。但温等人仍然

continuing their intrigue and often hold confidential
meetings with their confederates in the Cantonese Club.
I am a merchant and am impartial to the South &
North. If the revolutionists again incite shopkeepers
to go on strike and sever connexions with the
Government, it will be a menace to the peace and good
order of the district and endangers commercial business.
You will remember that in the 2nd year of Republic
(Yuan Shih-kai was then President) when the case of
Sung Chao-jen occurred, Chen Chi-mai established an
office in the French Concession, which was not suppressed
by the French Police. Later Chen caused an attack on
the Arsenal and the Woosung Forts, and at that time
the peace of the Settlement was greatly affected and
the merchants deeply distressed. The above will serve
as a warning.
I appreciate the protection given by your to
the residents and the maintenance of peace by your
Municipal Council, but I beg to point out that the
International Settlement should not be used as a place
for political movements. We therefore request your
Municipal Council to take strict & confidential
precautionary measures, thus to maintain peace and
merchants' business.
With compliments.
(Sd) Feng Zoh San.

2882
19年7月24日
继续其阴谋，并经常与其同伙在广东人俱乐部举行机密会议。
我是一名商人，对南北双方保持中立。如果革命党人再次煽动店主罢工并与政府断绝关系，这将威胁本地区的和平与良好秩序，并危及商业业务。
您会记得，在民国二年（当时袁世凯任总统）宋教仁案发生时，陈其美在法租界设立了一个办事处，法国警方未予取缔。后来陈其美发动了对兵工厂和吴淞炮台的攻击，当时租界的和平受到极大影响，商人深感痛苦。上述情况可作为警示。
我感激贵方给予居民的保护以及工部局对和平的维护，但我谨指出，公共租界不应被用作政治运动的场所。因此，我们请求贵工部局采取严格且保密的预防措施，以维持和平及商人的业务。
此致。
（签名）冯方珊（Feng Zoh San）。
